query: For a 56-year-old male: among men 51–61 admitted with postoperative complications, stratified by ICU vs non‑ICU, LOS (1–2/3–5/6–9/≥10) and Charlson comorbidity (0–1/2/≥3), report mortality (%), median LOS, CKD and diabetes prevalence.
final_sql:
SELECT
        a.hadm_id,
        CASE WHEN MAX(i.stay_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'ICU' ELSE 'Non-ICU' END AS icu_status
    FROM postoperative_admissions a
    LEFT JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays` i 
        ON a.subject_id = i.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = i.hadm_id
    GROUP BY a.hadm_id;
